name: Grolleau S.A.
summary: Established in Montilliers, France, in 1950, Grolleau S.A. specializes in designing, manufacturing, and distributing metal enclosures and protective shelters, offering robust solutions for complex environments throughout France. Their extensive product portfolio primarily caters to urban infrastructure, encompassing a wide array of cabinets—including aluminum, monobloc, stainless steel, lighting, signaling, traffic light, smart connectivity, gas, building, and water specific models. This is complemented by outdoor and electrical boxes, security vaults, various lighting systems (including components like traffic light mounting brackets and older embossed cones), road signs, quick stop stations, video surveillance equipment, and public market terminals. For the telecommunications sector, Grolleau supplies durable outdoor, indoor, and energy cabinets, alongside fiber optic node shelters. The company also provides bespoke solutions, crafting custom terminals, kiosks, and specialized cabinets. Furthermore, they contribute to green energy initiatives with electric vehicle charging stations, USB device charging points, and self-consumption control cabinets. Grolleau serves a broad customer base, including major accounts and operators, as well as clients in the urban development, telecommunications, green energy, and industrial sectors.
